description:
Customize the notification sound for the Flight Crew View application to ensure alerts are distinct. 

1. Open Android System Settings.
2. Navigate to 'Apps' > 'See all apps' > 'Flight Crew View'.
3. Go to the 'Notifications' section.
4. Tap on the text for the 'General' (or 'Miscellaneous') notification channel to open its detailed settings.
5. Tap 'Sound' (currently set to Default).
6. Change the sound to 'Chime', 'Carbon', or any other available tone that starts with the letter 'C'.
7. Save/Confirm the selection.
